title: 第13章 我第14章 万万不可
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
花乾走到一堆船体残块前，她用灵力也切割不动船体，不代表师叔祖不行。
师叔祖嘴里那一发攻击，直接把船给打毁，碎块跟着一起掉了下来，也被收集起来当废品卖。
“就这块吧，看起来还不错。”她从残块里挑了半丈宽的碎片，看起来是块船沿部分，上面还有些金色的装饰。
不知道北斗宗从哪弄来这么大的妖兽骨，但这头妖兽活着的时候最少也得是结丹中期了。
那小门派的男子看着这块废料，脸上的苦色不减反增，要它有何用，谁会买啊？
花乾没解释，用灵力把残块固定在半空中，在掌心招出一团火焰，然后张口吐出核桃大小的真火。
真火落在掌中的火焰里，瞬间火焰的最外层便多了圈浅蓝色。
这团小小的火焰被她扔向碎块，接触的瞬间火焰便猛然窜大，把它整个包裹在其中，熊熊火焰燃烧起来，火光在众人的脸上晃动。
众人对这并不陌生，筑基修士的真火，一般被修士拿来炼制各种东西。
那种能溶化各种灵材的地火和异火，非常的难得，还是用真火比较方便。
除了那些火灵根含量极为少的修士之外，每人都多少会修炼一些火系功法，也会把真火加入到火系功法中使用，可以增强火势。
但炼化灵材这个过程相当的耗时，她不会就这样随随便便就在此地熬几个月吧？
这块灵船兽骨最少是只结丹期妖兽，还这么大块，想要全部炼化可不容易。
大家正想散开，却发现火焰中的残块正在飞速熔化，众人愣住了，守灵门的新掌门是位炼器奇才？
花乾自然是知道自己露这一手，得震住在场的所有修士，尤其是某人。
她五行灵根火极旺四弱，是天生的火系功法修士，十三岁便筑基成功，是守灵门第六个在十八岁之前便筑基的弟子。
但因为她超过了一百岁，现在依旧是筑基初期的修为，总是被人以为她资质不好，是个老太太拼着命才能筑基的幸运儿。
一手火系功法被她用得出神入化，炼器更是她最擅长的事。
这种没有难度，只是品阶高级的灵材，对她来说比避开三小只去摘灵梨来偷吃还容易。
一个时辰不到，那块灵船残片全部化为了白色液体，旁边还有拳头大的一团金色液体，连船身上的金色装饰也被她分离出来。

花乾都没说休息一下，直接开始筑器。
众人像在看一场不要钱的好戏，一股股白色液体被分离，随着时间的流逝，火焰中慢慢出现了一套三十六支飞针组成的中品法器，两块中品灵盾，三把中品飞剑。
它们全是中品法器，而且每件上都有金色花纹，尤其是那三把飞剑，花纹精致通体白润，卖相极为上佳。
花乾灵力一收，火焰便自行熄灭，真火飞回口中。
她把这些法器用灵力送到了那男子面前，估计了一下说道：“你拿走吧，算你八年的利息。”
男子愣怔半天，满脸的不可置信。
“愣着干嘛，没见过像我这么优秀的炼器天才吗？”花乾抬起下巴得意地说道。
没想到那男子却怯懦地问道：“花掌门，中品法器能卖上中品灵石的价吗？”
花乾皱眉瞅向了他。
普通的下品法器按品质和用途，价格从几十灵石到几百下品灵石不等，再好也超过不了千位数的下品灵石。
而中品法器则要破千，像防具或是成套的法器，能卖得更高些，但绝对不可能过万。
下品灵石是日常消耗品，但中品灵石的地位就水涨船高了，一般是用在突然要消耗大量灵气的时候。
高级法阵的启动，修为进阶时冲击瓶颈，高阶傀儡的驱动，或是像吞灵炮这种特殊灵器上。
中品灵石能换下品灵石，但下品灵石却很难换到中品灵石。
花乾指着那三十六支灵针说道：“这套你卖两块中品灵石，下品灵石不交易便可。那两块灵盾各卖七八千块下品灵石没问题，材料用的是结丹期的兽骨，价格低不了。”
“这三把飞剑，你别随便卖人，你去找那几个最有名的筑基期美男俊才。你选个艳闻最多，身边总是跟着几个女修士的那种，去找他卖这三把灵剑。”
她笑道：“你开价两块中品灵石一把，肯定能全部卖掉。”
男子茫然地说：“哪有这种冤种啊？”
花乾沉默了几息，传音道，“你去灵虚上宫旁的桃缘城，在城中花仙楼里等着灵虚上宫的筑基第一人白不染，他喜欢花仙楼里的酒。”
“他肯定会买的。”她很肯定地说道。

白不染是苍风大陆非常出名的一位筑基修士，才二十来岁就已经是筑基后期圆满，而且他还劫杀过假丹修士。
假丹修士虽然实力只有结丹期修士的一半，但比筑基期那还是有天壤之别。
可就是这样，白不染还是杀了一名假丹修士，纵然对方有如此多的逃遁手段，都没能从他的手中成功逃走。
结丹之下第一人非他莫属。
这样的俊杰整个苍风大陆的修士，只要不是天天关洞府里不出门的都有耳闻其大名。
content_en:
Huagan walked to a pile of broken pieces of the ship's hull. Even with her spiritual power, she couldn't cut the ship's hull. It didn't mean that Uncle Shi couldn't do it.
The attack from Uncle Master's mouth directly destroyed the ship, and the pieces fell down together, and were collected and sold as scrap.
"Just this one, it looks pretty good." She picked out a half-foot-wide fragment from the remaining pieces. It looked like a ship's edge, and there were some golden decorations on it.
I don’t know where the Beidou Sect got such a large monster bone, but this monster must have been at least in the middle stage of forming the core when it was alive.
The man from the small sect looked at this piece of scrap, and the bitterness on his face increased instead of decreasing. What's the use of it? Who would buy it?
Huagan didn't explain, but used his spiritual power to fix the broken piece in mid-air, summoned a ball of flame in his palm, and then opened his mouth to spit out real fire the size of a walnut.
The real fire fell into the flame in the palm, and instantly there was a light blue circle on the outermost layer of the flame.
She threw this small ball of flame towards the broken pieces. The moment it came into contact, the flames suddenly grew in size, enveloping it completely. The flames burned brightly, and the firelight swayed on everyone's faces.
Everyone is no stranger to this. The true fire of the foundation-building monks is usually used by the monks to refine various things.
The kind of earthly fire and strange fire that can dissolve various spiritual materials are very rare, so it is more convenient to use real fire.
Except for those monks who have very little fire spirit root content, everyone can practice some fire-based exercises, and they can also add real fire to the fire-based exercises to increase the power of the fire.
But the process of refining spiritual materials is quite time-consuming. She won't just stay here for a few months, right?
This piece of spirit ship beast bone is at least a demon beast in the elixir formation stage, and it is so large that it will not be easy to refine it all.
Everyone was about to disperse, but found that the remaining pieces in the flames were melting rapidly. Everyone was stunned. Is the new head of the Soul Watching Sect a wizard of weapon refining?
Huagan naturally knew that if he showed his hand, all the monks present would be shocked, especially this certain person.
Her Five Elements Spiritual Roots are extremely strong and the other four are weak. She is a natural cultivator of the fire system. She successfully established the foundation at the age of thirteen. She is the sixth disciple of the Shou Ling Sect to establish the foundation before the age of eighteen.
But because she is over a hundred years old and is still in the early stage of foundation building, people always think that she has poor qualifications and is a lucky old lady who worked hard to build a foundation.
She uses the fire-based skills to perfection, and weapon refining is what she is best at.
This kind of spiritual material, which is not difficult and is only of high grade, is easier for her than avoiding three little ones to pick spiritual pears and eat them secretly.
In less than an hour, all the fragments of the spirit ship turned into white liquid, with a fist-sized ball of golden liquid next to it. Even the golden decorations on the ship were separated by her.
Huagan didn't even say to take a rest and started building the vessel directly.
Everyone seemed to be watching a free show. Streams of white liquid were separated. As time passed, a set of middle-grade magic weapons composed of thirty-six flying needles, two middle-grade spiritual shields, and three middle-grade flying swords slowly appeared in the flames.
They are all medium-grade magical instruments, and each one has golden patterns on them, especially the three flying swords. The patterns are exquisite and the whole body is white, making them look very good.
As soon as the spiritual power of the flower stem is withdrawn, the flame will extinguish itself, and the real fire will fly back into the mouth.
She used her spiritual power to send these magic weapons to the man, made an estimate and said, "Take them away and I'll calculate the interest for you for eight years."
The man was stunned for a long time, his face full of disbelief.
"Why are you standing there in a daze? Have you never seen a weapon-refining genius as good as me?" Hua Gan raised his chin and said proudly.
Unexpectedly, the man asked timidly: "Master Hua, can a middle-grade magic weapon be sold for the price of a middle-grade spiritual stone?"
Huagan frowned and looked at him.
Depending on the quality and use of ordinary low-grade magical instruments, the price ranges from dozens of spiritual stones to hundreds of low-grade spiritual stones. No matter how good they are, they cannot exceed the thousands of low-grade spiritual stones.
Medium-grade magic weapons cost more than a thousand, and armor or complete sets of magic weapons can be sold for even more.A bit higher, but definitely not over 10,000.
Low-grade spiritual stones are daily consumables, but the status of mid-grade spiritual stones has increased. They are usually used when a large amount of spiritual energy is suddenly consumed.
The activation of high-level magic circles, hitting bottlenecks when advancing in cultivation, driving high-level puppets, or special spiritual weapons like the Spirit-Swallowing Cannon.
Middle-grade spiritual stones can be exchanged for high-grade spiritual stones, but low-grade spiritual stones are difficult to exchange for middle-grade spiritual stones.
Huagan pointed at the thirty-six spiritual needles and said: "You can sell this set for two mid-grade spiritual stones, and the low-grade spiritual stones can be sold without trading. It's okay to sell the two spiritual shields for seven or eight thousand low-grade spiritual stones each. The materials are animal bones in the elixir-forming stage, so the price cannot be lower."
"Don't sell these three flying swords to anyone casually. Go find the most famous handsome men in the Foundation Establishment stage. Choose the one who has the most erotic stories and is always surrounded by several female monks, and go find him to sell these three spiritual swords."
She smiled and said: "If you offer two mid-grade spiritual stones for a handful, you can definitely sell them all."
The man said blankly: "How can there be such injustice?"
Huagan was silent for a few moments and then said through a message, "Go to Taoyuan City next to Lingxu Upper Palace. Bai Buran, the first person to build the foundation of Lingxu Upper Palace, is waiting in the Huaxian Tower in the city. He likes the wine in Huaxian Tower."
"He will definitely buy it," she said with certainty.
Bai Buran is a very famous foundation-building monk in Blue Wind Continent. He has already reached the late stage of foundation-building in his twenties, and he has also robbed and killed fake alchemy monks.
Although the strength of the fake elixir monks is only half of that of the monks in the elixir formation stage, it is still far different from that in the foundation establishment stage.
But even so, Bai Buran still killed a fake alchemy monk. Even though the other party had so many escape methods, he could not escape from his hands.
The first person under Jiedan is none other than him.
Such a handsome man, all the monks in the entire Blue Wind Continent have heard of his name, as long as they don't stay in the Cave Mansion every day.
